title: fix(example-showcase): the showcase_account extension declares the plural with its renamed label

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DBFhkQHTZPTwLSqiWCH7wN5)_

Fixes #30465

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — showcase example only

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：showcase 的 `showcase_account` 对象扩展在改名 `Account (Success Overlay)` 的同时补上复数 `Accounts (Success Overlay)`。
- 为什么改：PR #30459 之后，只改 label 不写复数的扩展不再返回旧复数，列表标题会退回单数名。
- 风险与回滚：只动示例与一条 dogfood 用例，无发布包；回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`examples/app-showcase/src/data/extensions/account.extension.ts`，再看 dogfood 文件里新增的 `[#30465]` 用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/showcase-object-extension-scalar-divergence.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 8 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `examples/app-showcase/src/data/extensions/account.extension.ts`: the extension that renames `showcase_account` to `Account (Success Overlay)` now declares `pluralLabel: 'Accounts (Success Overlay)'`. Since PR #30459 a rename without a plural is served with no plural, and the Console titles a list by the served plural, else the label; so the list title had fallen back to the singular.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-object-extension-scalar-divergence.dogfood.test.ts` (the file that already pins this object's served label): one new case. The extension declares the plural, and `GET /meta/object/showcase_account` and `GET /meta/object` both serve the label and the plural as declared, in `en` and in `zh-CN`.
- **No translation change.** The card asked for a zh-CN plural in `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/**` only if one is wanted. That bundle is the showcase's code catalog, not a `.custom` pair. `translateObject` reads a scalar that diverges from the packaged base only from the pair's catalog (#8284 comparison rule, ADR-0146 D2). So a zh-CN entry there would not be served for either string. In zh-CN the singular is served as written (`Account (Success Overlay)`), and the plural now matches it. The pin measures exactly that.

## Acceptance notes

- The commit message carries a `Fixes #30465` line. The dev contract keeps card relations to the PR body only. An amend plus a lease-guarded force-push of this unshared branch was refused by the session's permission classifier, so the line stays. It closes the same card this body closes.
